description: Dock at a station.
unlock_rule: docks >= 1 (dock:docked: the player confirms a dock at a station)

description: Mine ore from an asteroid or salvage it from a wreck.
unlock_rule: oreUnits >= 1 (mining:yield: ore or salvage released to the player (other miners excluded))

description: Buy or sell cargo at a station market.
unlock_rule: trades >= 1 (economy:tradeCompleted: a buy or a sell settles at a station market)

description: Complete a contract.
unlock_rule: contracts >= 1 (mission:completed: a contract settles as completed)

description: Jump to another system.
unlock_rule: jumps >= 1 (jump:arrive: the player arrives in another system)

description: Latch the Massline onto another body.
unlock_rule: latches >= 1 (tether:latched: the Massline latches a body)

description: Throw a body with the Massline.
unlock_rule: throws >= 1 (massline:throw: an armed Massline throw releases its payload)

description: Let go of a swing at the exact moment: a razor-rated release.
unlock_rule: razorReleases >= 1 (tether:releaseRated: a swing release is rated razor)

description: Whip a tethered mass into something at crushing speed.
unlock_rule: crushingImpacts >= 1 (tether:whipImpact: a whipped mass strikes a body at crushing speed)

description: Finish a Crucible run, however it ends.
unlock_rule: crucible.runs >= 1 (records.lifetime.runs: settled Crucible runs)

description: Reach wave 10 in the Crucible.
unlock_rule: crucible.deepestWave >= 10 (records.lifetime.deepestWave: deepest Crucible wave reached)

description: Beat your own best score in a Crucible challenge.
unlock_rule: crucibleBests >= 1 (run:resultsReady: a settled Crucible run beats the best score its challenge held before it)

description: Finish a Crucible daily run.
unlock_rule: crucible.dailyDays >= 1 (daily.byDate: days with a settled Crucible daily run)

description: Extract from a Crucible swarm at the refit bench instead of dying in it.
unlock_rule: crucibleExtractions >= 1 (run:resultsReady: a settled Crucible run ends by extraction)

description: Get yourself declared WANTED.
unlock_rule: wantedTimes >= 1 (heat:changed: heat crosses the WANTED threshold)

description: Earn 100,000 credits over your career.
unlock_rule: creditsEarned >= 100000 (credits:changed: credits granted to the player (sum of positive deltas))

description: Dock at ten stations.
unlock_rule: docks >= 10 (dock:docked: the player confirms a dock at a station)

description: Complete ten contracts.
unlock_rule: contracts >= 10 (mission:completed: a contract settles as completed)

description: Earn a million credits over your career.
unlock_rule: creditsEarned >= 1000000 (credits:changed: credits granted to the player (sum of positive deltas))

description: Bring aboard a thousand units of ore and salvage.
unlock_rule: oreUnits >= 1000 (mining:yield: ore or salvage released to the player (other miners excluded))

description: Complete twenty-five jumps.
unlock_rule: jumps >= 25 (jump:arrive: the player arrives in another system)

description: Throw fifty bodies with the Massline.
unlock_rule: throws >= 50 (massline:throw: an armed Massline throw releases its payload)

description: Release one ship under load into another hull.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected trickId bolas once

description: Kill with the mass that is still on the line.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected trickId wrecking_ball once

description: Kill a hull that crosses a loaded tether.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected trickId clothesline once

description: Wreck three or more hulls in one throw.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected collateralCount >= 3 once

description: Clear a kill-shot by a hair.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected trickId near_miss once

description: Tow a hostile into a fatal collision.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected trickId tow_kill once

description: Redirect a body into terrain for the kill.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected trickId rock_discovery once

description: Let a gravity well carry a body into a kill.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected trickId well_golf once

description: Put a wreck back in motion for a kill.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected trickId dead_mans_mass once

description: Bank a shot around cover that kills.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected trickId bank_job once

display_name: Back With Your Name On It
description: Return hostile ordnance to kill its owner.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected trickId return_to_sender once

description: Ride a blast's momentum clear of a threat.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected trickId kickstart once

description: Escape through a moving gap between two hulls.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected trickId needle_thread once

description: Correct a body with a second impulse into a kill.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected trickId one_two once

description: Pass a body from a rope through a well into a wreck.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected trickId slingshot_golf once

display_name: Two Hulls, One Rope, One Rock
description: Drive a Twin Bridle pair into terrain.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected variantId bolas_pair once

description: Shove a wreck into a hull of its own faction.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected variantId own_wingman once

description: Land a razor-rated release that kills.
unlock_rule: player stunt:trickDetected razor release that kills, once
